worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.summary: Identify a visible scent, temporarily lowering positive evasion and exposing Ghosts to Normal and Fighting. After losing sight, briefly remember and search the last observed position.
worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.use.0: run down a Ghost or a fast runner
worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.use.1: keep it lit up for a long time so it cannot hide
worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.use.2: set up a Normal or Fighting hit for an ally
worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.description: The scent mark lasts %1$s. Tracking experience adds %2$s to the last-seen memory duration; Normal and Fighting can hit Ghosts during the mark.
Base position memory is %1$s, capped at five seconds after the experience bonus. Only visible observations refresh it; occlusion leaves a fading old position.
worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.keen.on: Keen: %1$s wind-up and %2$s cooldown buy a longer trail and a longer smell range.
worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.keen.off: Dull: shorter window, faster wind-up and cooldown, closer range, good for frequent bites.
worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.description: Temporarily remove up to %1$s positive evasion stages at range %2$s, with %3$s preparation and %4$s recovery. First establish a visible subject; ending removes only this contribution.
worldcombat.skill.odorsleuth.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
Keen: window x1.7, reveal x1.3, +1.5 blocks of smell range, but +4 wind-up and +20 cooldown; off is shorter but faster, cheaper and closer.
The companion only considers Odor Sleuth within this distance of a threat; lower stays close, higher chases further.
When on, it will leave its post to smell the target out.
